steps.title: Ingest ADRs
steps.subtitle: Parse Markdown ADR sources into a stable index

deep.what: Normalize ADR documents into a content-addressed ingestion index with titles, paths, and body hashes.
how: Walk the ADR root and require a level-one title heading
Compute per-file SHA-256 for citation binding
Emit a machine index used by extract and assess joins
failure_modes: Missing H1 title rejects the document
Path escapes outside repository root are refused

deep.what: Heuristic extraction of obligation-like statements, then calibrated P(correct) + conformal bands (heuristic score is an input feature, not a probability).
how: Scan ADR bodies for modality cues (must/should/shall)
Compute heuristic triage score from modality, pattern hint, ambiguity, exceptions, compound cues (not 'citation clarity')
Apply Platt/logistic calibration → confidence_p; inductive conformal set → high|medium|low at target coverage
Label confidence_method=platt_conformal or honest heuristic fallback; low band is assist-eligible
failure_modes: Ambiguous prose widens conformal set / lands in low band
manual_review pattern hint when no executable verifier exists
Domain shift without gold refit voids coverage claims

deep.what: Confidence-gated batch assist that drafts normalized statements and pattern suggestions for humans.
how: Filter candidates at or below max_confidence (default low)
Offline provider emits deterministic fixtures when no key
Live OpenAI-compatible provider records token usage + estimated USD
Citation verified against source SHA + line ranges before emit
failure_modes: Missing API key forces offline mode

deep.what: Map assist proposals into review records or record reviews directly; compute accept_rate.
how: proposal-to-review maps a pending proposal into a ReviewProposal
accept-assist-proposal verifies citation drift then RecordReview
low-confidence-checklist emits Markdown for issue UX

deep.what: Deterministic requirement evaluation joined with obligation binding coverage.
how: OpenGrep / analyzer evidence bound to requirements
Obligation assessment joins candidates + reviews
Blocking gate fails on pending/stale/orphaned bindings
failure_modes: Non-zero runtime_llm_calls fails workshop-emit on assess workflows

deep.what: Flatten KPIs into workshop-metrics-v1 and publish via workshop-data + Pages.
how: Copy linked artifacts into snapshot
Compute accept_rate when registry+proposals present
Append metrics/runs.jsonl for trends
